name: Necromancer Dead Man Walking shortens roots and slows by 25% (#1519)
contract: Dead Man Walking 300233 is a Necromancer class-tree passive (CharacterAdvancement 33751, ClassType 25 = class 23, Tab 87 Class, AbilityEssenceCost 1) whose description reads 'Reduces the duration of root and slow effects against you by $s1%.' Both effects are native aura 232 SPELL_AURA_MECHANIC_DURATION_MOD on the caster, EffectBasePoints -26 + DieSides 1 = -25, MiscValue 7 (MECHANIC_ROOT) and 11 (MECHANIC_SNARE). The aura is not one of the family-29 aura 42/354 effects the Necromancer contract turns into dummies, and Unit::ModSpellDuration reads GetTotalAuraModifierByMiscValue(SPELL_AURA_MECHANIC_DURATION_MOD, mechanic) for every harmful aura a real cast lands on the recipient, so no script is required. Fixtures: Chains of Ice 113 (spell Mechanic 7, one MOD_ROOT effect, DurationIndex 31 = 8000 ms) and Curse of Exhaustion 65815 (spell Mechanic 11, one MOD_DECREASE_SPEED effect, DurationIndex 29 = 12000 ms), both cast by a hostile creature ten levels above the players so the spell hit roll cannot miss; each player receives each spell once, so diminishing returns cannot shorten either application. The untalented control must keep 8000 ms and 12000 ms; the Necromancer with Dead Man Walking must get 6000 ms and 9000 ms.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
The Dead Man Walking passive aura is applied

SETUP: the root lands on the Necromancer
DISCRIMINATING: Dead Man Walking cuts the root to 6 seconds

CONTROL: the slow keeps its 12 second duration
SETUP: the slow lands on the Necromancer
DISCRIMINATING: Dead Man Walking cuts the slow to 9 seconds
